description.value: The study examined neural correlates of emotion acceptance as an emotion regulation strategy compared with worry and suppression in female participants with generalized anxiety disorder using fMRI.

spans.text: The current study explores the mechanisms of emotion acceptance as an alternate emotion regulation strategy to worry or emotion suppression using functional magnetic resonance imaging.

instructions.value: Participants silently read personally relevant worry statements and then regulated their reactions according to one of three instructions: “Observe and accept” in the Accept condition, “Don’t think or feel” in the Suppress condition, or “Worry as usual” in the Worry condition. After each regulation block they rated how distressed they felt from 1 (Not at all) to 4 (Extremely).
